name: GiveMeANode
summary: Official hosted MCP server for agent-driven GPU nodes, jobs, storage, logs, metrics, and isolated sandboxes.
read_operations: Node, job, storage, log, metric, and account inspection
GPU catalog and resource availability inspection
upstream_write_operations: Create, start, stop, and delete billable GPU resources
Submit or cancel jobs and run commands
Upload or delete storage objects and manage sandboxes
safety: One click saves the exact reviewed endpoint off, then opens browser OAuth. MCP credentials, configured headers, and local connector environment values are encrypted at rest. Setup does not invoke a tool or create a paid resource; every later invocation still crosses MCP permissions. Review billing limits and stop or delete resources explicitly.
requirements: A GiveMeANode account
One browser OAuth 2.1 approval
Billing limits reviewed before any paid compute invocation

name: GitHub
summary: GitHub's official hosted MCP server for repositories, issues, pull requests, releases, and code search.
safety: The reviewed setup saves disabled. After connecting, inspect the discovered tool list and OAuth scopes before approving any invocation. OpenScience does not label the upstream server read-only; every invocation still crosses the MCP permission boundary.
requirements: A GitHub account
Organization approval where required
Explicit review of requested OAuth scopes

name: Benchling
summary: Benchling's official tenant-specific remote MCP server provides governed, user-authorized access to Benchling scientific data.
read_operations: Natural-language queries over tenant scientific data
Structured summaries, tables, comparisons, and source links
safety: The endpoint is tenant-specific and uses delegated OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration. This catalog does not claim ELN write-back and does not guess or store your tenant URL.
requirements: Benchling Enterprise with Benchling Chat and MCP enabled by a tenant administrator
The exact https://<tenant>.mcp.benchling.com/mcp endpoint
V3 APIs enabled and user access reviewed

name: Box
summary: Box's official hosted MCP endpoint for Box content and Box AI features.
safety: The reviewed setup saves disabled. Create a dedicated Box integration, then inspect its discovered tools and scopes before approving any invocation. Box's server includes write tools; OpenScience does not call them trusted.
requirements: A Box enterprise account with MCP enabled
A dedicated client ID and secret
Reviewed Box content scopes

name: Dropbox
summary: Dropbox publishes a source repository for its Dash search MCP server, but no reviewed hosted endpoint is bundled.
read_operations: File metadata and content reads requested by the upstream server
safety: OpenScience will not clone or execute a moving Git branch. Pin and review a commit, install it outside the app, then add its exact local command manually with read-only Dropbox scopes.
requirements: A pinned reviewed upstream commit
Python 3.10+ and uv
A Dropbox app with metadata/content read scopes

name: Amazon S3
summary: S3 access through AWS's official managed MCP server and the user's existing IAM identity.
read_operations: S3 object and bucket reads permitted by IAM
upstream_write_operations: AWS API calls, including S3 mutations when IAM permits them
safety: The reviewed setup saves disabled. The AWS MCP endpoint is broader than S3; use a dedicated least-privilege IAM identity, connect, and inspect tools before approving any invocation. CloudTrail remains the authoritative external audit log.
requirements: An AWS account
OAuth access to AWS MCP Server
A least-privilege IAM policy limited to intended S3 resources

name: IBM SPSS Statistics
summary: Community MCP server that drives a locally installed IBM SPSS Statistics engine: instant .sav I/O through pyreadstat, plus statistical procedures executed by one persistent SPSS process that keeps datasets alive across calls.
read_operations: Variable dictionary: names, labels, formats, value labels, measurement level, row count
Data rows previewed as CSV, limited by row and column
.sav to CSV and CSV to .sav conversion
Statistical procedure output tables returned as text
upstream_write_operations: Writes new .sav files when converting CSV input
Executes arbitrary SPSS syntax, and arbitrary Python inside the SPSS Python integration
safety: This is an unreviewed community server rather than a vendor endpoint, so it is catalogued manual_review: the dispatcher will not clone, install or run it for you. Install it yourself from a pinned commit and inspect the registered tool list before approving any call. Anything it accepts runs against a real SPSS engine on your machine, so treat run-syntax and run-python as code execution. Review the generated .sps before letting it run, and prefer read-only analysis.
requirements: Windows with IBM SPSS Statistics installed together with its Python integration plugin (Python3\python.exe under the SPSS installation directory)
Python 3.10+ on PATH, with pyreadstat installed
The real local path to mcp_server.py; set SPSS_PY when SPSS is not in its default location, and SPSS_CALL_TIMEOUT to raise the per-call timeout
install_steps: 安装唯一依赖：pip install pyreadstat --index-url <上方 PyPI 镜像>
把 mcp_server.py 与 spsscli.py 复制到一个固定目录（例如 %USERPROFILE%\.spss-mcp）
把下方配置里的 <安装目录> 换成该真实路径——含占位符时本工具会拒绝写入
重启客户端，确认 spss_dict / spss_run_syntax / spss_reset_engine 等工具已出现

alternatives.name: Exekiel179/SPSS-MCP
alternatives.note: 36 个高层语义工具（spss_t_test / spss_anova / spss_regression / Cox 等），并附 spss-analyst 工作流技能，上手门槛更低。未选原因：自 2026-04 起无新提交；其 configure-claude 会改写 Claude Code 专属的 ~/.claude.json，与本包通用的 mcpServers 模型不合；预置工具越多，单点 bug 的暴露面越大。若你更想要开箱即用的命名工具而不想自己写 SPSS 语法，它同样可用，按同一流程手工登记即可。
